name: Meeting Assistant
author: shreeve1
description: Researches questions and claims from a live meeting transcript and shows Research Cards on an Overlay, with an Ask box for follow-up questions. The Overlay takes keyboard focus only while the Ask box is open.

barWidget.description: Shows researching and paused state, and pauses or dismisses Research Cards from the bar. SUPER + M opens the Ask box.

schema.label: Overlay monitor
schema.description: Monitor name for the Overlay. Empty uses the focused monitor. The Ask box always opens on the focused monitor.

schema.label: Ask model
schema.description: Model for the Ask agent. Separate from the research model.

schema.label: Ask skill
schema.description: Bare skill name, sent as /skill:<name> with the first Ask message of each Meeting. Empty means none.

schema.label: Persona file
schema.description: Read when the Ask agent starts, so edits apply after it restarts. Created from the shipped default if missing.
